name: Nemzeti Közpénzkereső
storyline: Set in a satirical, exaggerated version of modern-day Hungary, Nemzeti Közpénzkereső (National Public Funds Sweeper) is a political puzzle game that lets you experience systemic corruption from two opposing sides. In the Oligarch Campaign, you play as a regime-backed frontman navigating a grid of iconic, overpriced state investments to extract public funds into offshore accounts, using bribes and political passives to dodge the authorities. Alternatively, in the K9 Campaign, you take on the role of an incorruptible sniffer dog tasked with tracking down and confiscating these stolen billions, using your unique animal instincts to bypass legal blockades, outsmart the corrupt elite, and return the wealth to the state.
summary:
Will you sniff out the billions, or stash them away? Nemzeti Közpénzkereső is a fast-paced, timed Minesweeper-style puzzle game where Hungarian reality meets the classic logic challenge. Choose your side and race against the relentlessly ticking seconds across six increasingly brutal domestic locations.

In Public Funds Sniffer Dog mode you command the elite K9 unit of the NVVH, sniffing out hidden billions and confiscating them for the state treasury while avoiding lawyer blockades. In NER Oligarchs mode you step into the shoes of one of four cunning strawmen and move embezzled public funds to offshore accounts before the NVVH cracks down on you.
